verdict.rationale: ReelMimic's AI analyzes the user's own reference video into shot count, lengths, BPM, transitions, colors, framing and camera moves. It then proposes a storyboard and style frames you can discuss in chat, and writes up a new-style proposal when the reference doesn't match a known style. These are in-product AI insights and suggestions, but they are limited to analyzing a single reference video for production planning, not insights across a user's data more broadly. Missing for 10: insights beyond reference-video breakdown (e.g., over the user's projects or outputs), proactive improvement recommendations, independent or hands-on corroboration of analysis quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Breaks down the reference. Shot count, shot lengths, BPM, transitions, colors, framing and camera moves.
Shows you the plan first. Storyboard, characters, assets and a few style frames. Chat about it until you like it, then approve.
When a reference doesn't match a known style, it uses the closest engine and writes up a proposal for a new style.
